geometry: Retain Art/HeroShip verbatim; no hull/collider/UV/anchor changes

energyChannels.G: 0.12 full-hull floor plus low-amplitude existing surface-edge mask

boost.rule: Material-only on IsBoosting. No shield, transparency, geometry morph or gameplay.

normalizedBindings._VRThrust: engine brightness only; preserve 0.25 idle minimum at core
normalizedBindings._VRBoost: blend energy floor, accent emission and local cyan Fresnel outline
normalizedBindings._VRBoostIgnition: <=80 ms cyan-white accent emphasis, never whole-screen white
normalizedBindings._VRBoostRelease: 180 ms hull energy decay; already emitted particles follow their lifetime

shaderRequestsFor03: Use local per-renderer material properties; exclude canopy glass/nozzle interiors from whole-hull fill. Keep saturated cyan accents and a solid dark mass. Proposed emission: colour*(3.4*R + .45*G + 1.8*edgeFresnel)*boost, with soft bounded silhouette width.
limitations: R mask follows existing livery. G includes a constant floor and UV texture-edge detail, not geometric curvature. Outline comes from shader, not the bitmap.
